request: sourdough starter feeding log. time, flour g, water g, jar temp, did it double?

checklist.item: can add a feeding with time, flour grams and water grams
shows the ratio flour to water

program:
app "Starter log" bread mint
table feed fed when = now "Time", flour num 1.. unit "g", water num 1.. unit "g", temp num 0..45 unit "C" "Jar temp", doubled bool "Did it double?"
stat fixed(last(feed.water) / last(feed.flour), 2), "last water to flour ratio"
form feed, "Add feeding"
each feed as f empty "No feedings yet"
  row card tap edit f swipe remove f
    stack grow gap 0
      f.fed bold
      f.flour "g flour," f.water "g water" faint
      "ratio" fixed(f.water / f.flour, 2) f.temp "C" faint
    icon if(f.doubled, "check", "minus")
describe:
Starter log, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- feed: "Time": date and time, starts at now; flour: number, at least 1, in g; water: number, at least 1, in g; "Jar temp": number, 0 to 45, in C; "Did it double?": yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a big number: the fixed of the latest water of feed divided by the latest flour of feed, labelled "last water to flour ratio".
- a form to add a feed.
- for each feed:
  - a group; a tap opens the feed for editing; a swipe removes the feed, with undo:
    - text: the fed of the feed.
    - text: the flour of the feed, "g flour,", the water of the feed, "g water".
    - text: "ratio", the fixed of the water of the feed divided by the flour of the feed, the temp of the feed, "C".
    - an icon.

request: Kids screen time: each of my 2 kids gets 90 minutes a day. I press start when they begin and stop when they finish. Show how many minutes are left today for each.

checklist.item: two kids with their own timers or counters

program:
app "Screen time" phone ocean
table use kid pick Kid_1|Kid_2, spent dur
state cur pick Nobody|Kid_1|Kid_2 = Nobody
state st when = now
setting allowance dur = 90m "Daily allowance"
let left(sp dur, on bool) = max(allowance - sp - if(on, now - st, 0s), 0s) / 1m
def kidrow name text, mins num, on bool, go act, stop act
  stack card gap 1
    row gap 2 align center
      text name bold grow
      text mins big
      text "min left" faint
    if on
      button "Stop" tap stop
    else
      button "Start" tap go
kidrow "Kid 1", left(sum(use.spent today where kid = Kid_1), cur = Kid_1), cur = Kid_1, set st = now then set cur = Kid_1, add use kid = Kid_1, spent = now - st then set cur = Nobody
kidrow "Kid 2", left(sum(use.spent today where kid = Kid_2), cur = Kid_2), cur = Kid_2, set st = now then set cur = Kid_2, add use kid = Kid_2, spent = now - st then set cur = Nobody
describe:
Screen time, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- use: kid: one of Kid 1, Kid 2; spent: length of time. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Daily allowance": length of time, starts at 90 minutes.
Remembers while you use it: cur, starting at Nobody; st, starting at now.
Shows:
- defines a part called kidrow, taking name, mins, on, go, stop.
- the part kidrow defined in this app, given "Kid 1"; left of the total spent of use today where kid is Kid 1 and cur is Kid 1; cur is Kid 1; sets st to now, then sets cur to Kid 1; adds a use with kid set to Kid 1, spent set to now minus st, then sets cur to Nobody.
- the part kidrow defined in this app, given "Kid 2"; left of the total spent of use today where kid is Kid 2 and cur is Kid 2; cur is Kid 2; sets st to now, then sets cur to Kid 2; adds a use with kid set to Kid 2, spent set to now minus st, then sets cur to Nobody.

request: how many litres of emulsion for the drawing room? 14 ft by 12 ft, 10 ft high, 2 doors 1 window, two coats, a litre covers about 100 sq ft

checklist.item: inputs for length, width, height, doors, windows, coats
uses coverage of about 100 sq ft per litre

program:
app "Paint litres" pen ocean
state len num = 14
state wid num = 12
state high num = 10
state doors num = 2
state windows num = 1
state coats num = 2
setting cover num 10.. = 100 "Sq ft per litre"
let walls = 2 * (len + wid) * high - doors * 21 - windows * 15
let litres = walls * coats / cover
stack card gap 2
  field len "Length (ft)"
  field wid "Width (ft)"
  field high "Height (ft)"
  field doors "Doors"
  field windows "Windows"
  field coats "Coats"
stat 0 - floor(0 - litres), "litres of emulsion to buy"
"Paintable wall area" walls "sq ft (door 21, window 15)" faint
"Exact need" fixed(litres, 1) "litres" faint
describe:
Paint litres, in the ocean colours.
You can change: "Sq ft per litre": number, at least 10, starts at 100.
Works out:
- walls is 2 times the result of len plus wid times high minus doors times 21 minus windows times 15.
- litres is walls times coats divided by cover.
Remembers while you use it: len, starting at 14; wid, starting at 12; high, starting at 10; doors, starting at 2; windows, starting at 1; coats, starting at 2.
Shows:
- a box to fill in len, labelled "Length (ft)".
- a box to fill in wid, labelled "Width (ft)".
- a box to fill in high, labelled "Height (ft)".
- a box to fill in doors, labelled "Doors".
- a box to fill in windows, labelled "Windows".
- a box to fill in coats, labelled "Coats".
- a big number: 0 minus 0 minus litres rounded down, labelled "litres of emulsion to buy".
- text: "Paintable wall area", walls, "sq ft (door 21, window 15)".
- text: "Exact need", the fixed of litres, "litres".

request: Chicken coop egg count. Number of eggs each day from 12 hens, how many cracked. Weekly total and avg per hen per day. Sell eggs at 40 rs each so show income too.

checklist.item: can add a day with eggs collected and cracked count
shows average per hen per day using 12 hens
shows income at 40 rs per egg

program:
app "Egg count" egg mint
table eggs day date = today, n num 0.. "Eggs collected", cracked num 0.. = 0
setting hens num 1.. = 12 "Hens"
setting price money = 40 "Price per egg (Rs)"
let mon = today - weekday(today) + 1
let wk = sum(eggs.n where day >= mon)
row gap 3
  stat wk, "eggs this week"
  stat fixed(wk / (hens * 7), 2), "per hen per day"
stat sum(eggs where day >= mon, (it.n - it.cracked) * price), "income this week (Rs)"
form eggs, "Add day"
"Eggs per day" head
daybars last 14 days, sum(eggs.n where day = it)
list eggs by day
describe:
Egg count, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- eggs: day: date, starts at today; "Eggs collected": number, at least 0; cracked: number, at least 0, starts at 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Hens": number, at least 1, starts at 12; "Price per egg (Rs)": money, starts at 40.
Works out:
- mon is today minus the weekday number of today plus 1.
- wk is the total n of eggs where day is at least mon.
Shows:
- a big number: wk, labelled "eggs this week".
- a big number: the fixed of wk divided by the result of hens times 7, labelled "per hen per day".
- a big number: the sum of the result of its n minus its cracked times price over the eggs where day is at least mon, labelled "income this week Rs".
- a form to add a eggs.
- text: "Eggs per day".
- a bar chart of the total n of eggs where day is the item for each day in the last 14 days.
- a list of eggs by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

request: ludo turn tracker for 4 players red green yellow blue, whose turn it is, count of sixes rolled

checklist.item: button to move to next turn
counts sixes per player or total

program:
app "Ludo turns" dice ink
table six p num 0..3
state turn num = 0 keep
grid 2 gap 2
  each ["Red", "Green", "Yellow", "Blue"] as nm
    stack card align center gap 1 fill if(index = 0, red, if(index = 1, green, if(index = 2, yellow, blue))) opacity if(index = turn, 1, 0.35)
      nm bold
      if(index = turn, "Your turn", "") small
      count(six where p = index) "sixes" small
"Sixes rolled:" count(six) big
row gap 1
  button "Rolled a 6" tap add six p = turn
  button "Next turn" tap set turn = (turn + 1) % 4
button "Reset game" tap remove all six then set turn = 0
describe:
Ludo turns, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- six: p: number, 0 to 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: turn, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a grid of 2 columns:
  - for "Red", "Green", "Yellow", "Blue":
    - text: the value.
    - text: "Your turn" when its position is turn, otherwise "".
    - text: how many six entries where p is its position, "sixes".
- text: "Sixes rolled:", how many six entries.
- a button "Rolled a 6"; a tap adds a six with p set to turn.
- a button "Next turn"; a tap sets turn to the result of turn plus 1 leaves over when divided by 4.
- a button "Reset game"; a tap removes all six entries, with one undo, then sets turn to 0.

request: zakat for my wife's jewellery and our savings. gold in tola, silver in tola, cash at home, and i type today's rate per tola

checklist.item: inputs for gold tola, silver tola and cash
rate per tola for gold and silver can be typed
computes 2.5 percent of the total value

program:
app "Zakat" coin mint
state gold num = 0
state gold_rate money = 0
state silver num = 0
state silver_rate money = 0
state cash money = 0
let total = gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate + cash
let nisab = 52.5 * silver_rate
stack card gap 2
  field gold "Gold (tola)"
  field gold_rate "Gold rate per tola"
  field silver "Silver (tola)"
  field silver_rate "Silver rate per tola"
  field cash "Cash at home and savings"
"Total wealth" total head
stat total * 0.025, "zakat due (2.5 percent)"
if silver_rate > 0
  if total >= nisab
    "Above nisab (52.5 tola silver = " nisab "): zakat is due" color good
  else
    "Below nisab (" nisab "): no zakat due" color warn
describe:
Zakat, in the mint colours.
Works out:
- total is gold times gold rate plus silver times silver rate plus cash.
- nisab is 52.5 times silver rate.
Remembers while you use it: gold, starting at 0; gold rate, starting at 0; silver, starting at 0; silver rate, starting at 0; cash, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a box to fill in gold, labelled "Gold (tola)".
- a box to fill in gold rate, labelled "Gold rate per tola".
- a box to fill in silver, labelled "Silver (tola)".
- a box to fill in silver rate, labelled "Silver rate per tola".
- a box to fill in cash, labelled "Cash at home and savings".
- text: "Total wealth", total.
- a big number: total times 0.025, labelled "zakat due 2.5 percent".
- if silver rate is more than 0:
  - if total is at least nisab:
    - text: "Above nisab (52.5 tola silver = ", nisab, "): zakat is due".
  - otherwise:
    - text: "Below nisab (", nisab, "): no zakat due".

request: speech practice timer, set minutes, shows green then yellow in last minute then red at zero

checklist.item: colour changes green then yellow then red

program:
app "Speech timer" clock ocean
state mins num = 5
state held dur
state paused bool = no
state ends when = now
state going bool = no
let left = if(going, max(ends - now, 0s), if(paused, held, 1m * mins))
when going and now >= ends set going = no then set paused = no then notify "Time is up"
field mins "Minutes"
box card pad 3 fill if(left <= 0s, bad, if(left <= 60s, warn, good))
  text left huge align center
row gap 1
  if going
    button "Pause" tap set held = ends - now then set paused = yes then set going = no
  else
    button "Start" tap set ends = now + if(paused, held, 1m * mins) then set going = yes
  button "Reset" tap set going = no then set paused = no
describe:
Speech timer, in the ocean colours.
Works out:
- left is the larger of ends minus now and 0 hours when going, otherwise held when paused, otherwise 1 minute times mins.
Remembers while you use it: mins, starting at 5; held; paused, starting at no; ends, starting at now; going, starting at no.
Shows:
- when going and now is at least ends, it sets going to no, then sets paused to no, then shows the notice "Time is up".
- a box to fill in mins, labelled "Minutes".
- text: left.
- if going:
  - a button "Pause"; a tap sets held to ends minus now, then sets paused to yes, then sets going to no.
- otherwise:
  - a button "Start"; a tap sets ends to now plus held when paused, otherwise 1 minute times mins, then sets going to yes.
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets going to no, then sets paused to no.

program:
app "Tuition centre" school ocean
table student name text, class text, fee money
table payment student ref student, amount money, paid_on date = today
table present student ref student
remind "Collect this month's fees" monthly on 5 at 9:00
stat sum(payment.amount month), "fees collected this month"
"Fees collected per month" head
bars 0..5, sum(payment.amount month of addmonths(today, it - 5)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 5))
"Students" head
form student, "Add student"
each student as s empty "No students yet"
  row card tap edit s swipe remove s
    stack gap 0 grow
      s.name bold
      s.class faint
    s.fee
    toggle s.present
"Not paid this month" head
each student as s
  if count(s.payment month) = 0
    row card
      s.name grow
      s.fee color bad
"Record a payment" head
form payment, "Save payment"
describe:
Tuition centre, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- student: name: text; class: text; fee: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- payment: student: a student; amount: money; paid on: date, starts at today. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- present: student: a student. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- a big number: the total amount of payment this month, labelled "fees collected this month".
- text: "Fees collected per month".
- a bar chart of the total amount of payment in the month of today moved by the item minus 5 months for each of number from 0 to 5.
- text: "Students".
- a form to add a student.
- for each student:
  - a group; a tap opens the student for editing; a swipe removes the student, with undo:
    - text: the name of the student.
    - text: the class of the student.
    - text: the fee of the student.

- text: "Not paid this month".
- for each student:

    - text: the name of the student.
    - text: the fee of the student.
- text: "Record a payment".
- a form to add a payment.
Reminder "Collect this month's fees" every month on day 5 at 9:00.
